scene: The unlocked gate reveals Grand Transit Plaza's lively terminals.
picture: Flat pixel-art side view along a stone platform. On the far left, a silver monorail carriage waits on elevated rails. To the left of centre, the elderly bearded man in cap and cardigan stands with his cane. In the centre sits a red funicular tram. On the far right, a striped water taxi bobs.
